name: saksae-static
description: SAKSAE marketing site — static HTML/CSS/JS, Tailwind as the only build step.

scripts.deploy: npm run build:v2 && node deploy-v2.mjs && node check-v2.mjs
scripts.deploy:v1: npm run build && npm run check && node deploy.mjs
scripts.i18n: python3 -I v2/i18n.py extract && python3 -I v2/i18n.py build
